body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties and one ordinary morale-based Success Die penalty until the start of your next turn. No injury changes.

surges.html: Extend only the Wound suppression through the end of your next turn.
The target becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Vow
rider.html: Vow: do not voluntarily leave the target more than 3 units away before your next turn. Spend this Authority when it is damaged to let it move 1 unit afterward; breaking the Vow discards it.
